limitations: This raw CSV is a Decision OS session compilation across explicitly named original institutions. The issue URL identifies this compilation, not an original statistical publisher. Every row retains its original product/family, source URL and provenance; no institution endorsement is implied.

Use the existing read-source operation for factual reading. This is deliberately not the16-column homogeneous industry-price table; no new numerical reader, schedule, valuation, issuer exposure or price-comparison capability is claimed.

Scalar observations, forecast vintages, preliminary statistics, source ranges, published changes, inventories, flows, costs, ratios and indices remain different. No back-calculated historical level, synthetic midpoint, unit conversion or inferred missing observation is supplied.

source_value_text preserves source strings, including currency symbols, decimal commas, raw cached Excel precision, null and market-closure sentinels. Blank value_text for source ranges/null/closures is intentional; range_low/high are the original endpoints, never a manufactured average.

A later report may revise an earlier reference period. Current downloaded snapshots do not certify first-publication timing or immutable historical vintages. Source flags and report/crop-year differences remain per row.

original_sha256, bytes and acquired_at refer only to the actual source response named by original_url. For web_original_only rows they are blank; extraction_manifest_sha256 and extraction_pointer identify the separately frozen local factual extraction, not a fabricated original page hash.

Only necessary attributed numerical facts from the accepted publication subset are included. The eight commercial/subscription/noncommercial-boundary products are omitted; general database mirroring rights are not claimed.

Already saved FAO FFPI, MARA daily wholesale and MARA livestock successor observations are excluded from these candidates. Source families, products, entities and fact rows have different counts; none is a count of newly monitored independent commodities.

Each Entity describes an original data product as a concept. Rows can contain several commodity/region/unit series under that product; this does not assert that product-level entities are physical commodities or mutually additive series.
